manifest.name: dsh-local-bridge
manifest.description: Durable same-machine messaging between DeepSeek Harness (DSH) conversations: local hub, DSH host plugin, CLI.

bundle.text:
# Profile bundle layer for the DSH Local Bridge.
# Installed as a profile dependency: the package root is the Cordis plugin entry
# (see package.json "main"), and this row mounts it.
- insert:
    - id: local-agent-bridge
      name: dsh-local-bridge
      config:
        enabled: true

readme.text:
简体中文 | [English](README.en.md)

> 同一台 Windows 机器上，为多个 DeepSeek Harness（DSH）对话提供持久、可审计的本地消息投递与唤醒。

**状态：alpha / 研究预览。** 这是一个个人向、Windows 优先的项目，不是成熟产品；支持面刻意保持很窄。使用前请先读“这不是什么”。

- 一个只监听 `127.0.0.1` 的**本地 Hub**：持久状态、TTL、重试、去重、配对白名单、审计事件。
- 一个 **DSH 宿主插件**：把入站消息投递到精确的、存活的 DSH 会话，并注册 `bridge_send`、`bridge_status`、`bridge_targets` 工具。
- 一个 **CLI**：Hub 生命周期、配对、发送、状态、消费，以及可逆的插件安装/卸载。
- 面向同一台 Windows 机器上的单用户、多 DSH 对话。

“投递成功”的定义是：目标 DSH 对话收到消息，并且宿主启动了模型 turn。Hub 接受消息不等于投递成功。

- 不是通用 agent-to-agent 协议。
- 不是跨机、云服务或多用户服务。
- 不是无人值守的 Codex 桥。新版 bundle **附带**可选的 Codex receiver 源码、worker 入口和 shared core metadata，但 receiver/worker 默认不启用；必须由真实原 Codex owner 显式 opt-in/配对后才可能启动。它仍是实验性、强版本依赖的；legacy/source-link 模式保持独立说明，不会被自动迁移。
- 不是 GUI，也不是托管产品。
- 不保证兼容测试版本以外的 DSH 版本。
- 不承诺“开箱即用”支持所有 DSH 对话。

```text
DSH 对话 A
  └─ 宿主插件（出站工具）──┐
                          ▼
                   本地 Hub（127.0.0.1）

Hub 只监听 loopback。配对是显式白名单：未配对身份不能发送或接收。运行态（令牌、队列、日志、插件备份）在 `.local/`，永不提交。

- Windows 10/11（本 alpha 仅支持 Windows；已测试）。
- Node.js 22 或 24。
- DSH Desktop 0.2.1-rc.2（测试版本；其他版本可能可用但未验证）。
- 单用户、单机。

把 `<session-id>` 换成真实的 DSH 会话 ID。所有命令在仓库根目录执行。

```powershell
node --test

readme.section: 创建本地运行配置（令牌、Hub 状态目录）
readme.text: node bin/lab-bridge.mjs init

readme.section: 终端 1：启动 Hub，并保持运行
readme.text: node hub/main.mjs

readme.section: 终端 2：检查可达性，并配对 DSH 会话
readme.text:
node bin/lab-bridge.mjs check
node bin/lab-bridge.mjs pair add 'dsh:session-<session-id>' --label 'DSH session'

readme.section: 安装 DSH 宿主插件（可逆；先写备份，再改 profile）
readme.text:
node bin/lab-bridge.mjs install-dsh-plugin
node bin/lab-bridge.mjs dsh-plugin-status
```

在已配对的 DSH 对话中：

```text
bridge_send to='dsh:session-<session-id>' text='hello'
bridge_status msg_id='<message-id>'
bridge_service_status
```

CLI 操作：

readme.section: 安装 DSH 宿主插件（可逆；先写备份，再改 profile）
readme.text:
```powershell
node bin/lab-bridge.mjs send --to 'dsh:session-<session-id>' --text 'hello through the bridge'
node bin/lab-bridge.mjs status --msg-id <message-id>
node bin/lab-bridge.mjs consume --msg-id <message-id> --consumer 'dsh:session-<session-id>' --note 'handled'
node bin/lab-bridge.mjs service-status
```

readme.section: 作为 DSH bundle 安装（alpha）
readme.text:
DSH 的插件管理器可以从 GitHub 或本地路径安装 bundle。安装后插件会**自动启动并管理 Hub**（已有 Hub 会复用；设置 `manageHub: false` 可自行管理）。Hub 仍是独立子进程，但用户不需要手动定位 node_modules 里的 CLI。Hub 子进程异常退出时，companion 会按有界退避自动重启它；已有/外部 Hub 只复用，不停止。

> 插件管理器需要 `pnpm`；如果 CLI 报 `pnpm not found`，请先安装 pnpm，或使用 Desktop 插件页的安装入口。安装会做版本/构建检查，可能要求确认。

```powershell

readme.section: GitHub（需要 DSH 0.2.1-rc.2；bundle 声明了 engines.dsh）
readme.text: dsh plugin --profile web add github:suancaiyu10108899/dsh-local-bridge
dsh plugin --profile web add D:\Dev\dsh-local-bridge-public

readme.section: 安装后的 bundle 使用 $DSH_HOME/local-agent-bridge/runtime 作为运行态目录
readme.text:
$cli = "$env:USERPROFILE\.dsh\profiles\web\node_modules\.bin\dsh-local-bridge.cmd"
& $cli init       # 仅首次；插件启动 Hub 时也会创建配置/令牌
& $cli pair add 'dsh:session-<session-id>' --label 'DSH session'
& $cli check      # 诊断用；Hub 已由插件管理时无需手动 serve
& $cli service-status
```

如果关闭自动管理（`manageHub: false`），再用 `& $cli serve` 显式启动 Hub。

如果本地 checkout 用 `link:` 安装，运行态仍跟随 checkout 的 `.local/runtime`；从源码运行时继续使用上面的快速开始即可。

readme.section: 手动接入 / 请求查询（当前入口）
readme.text:
需要把一个新 source/target 手动接入、持久登记请求并查询失败/重试/撤销时，使用当前入口：

- [docs/MANUAL-ONBOARDING.md](docs/MANUAL-ONBOARDING.md)
- [受限 client access](docs/CLIENT-ACCESS.md)
- [DSH companion lifecycle](docs/COMPANION-LIFECYCLE.md)
- [Restricted-client rollback / old-Hub handover](docs/CLIENT-ROLLBACK.md)
- CLI：`node bin/lab-bridge.mjs onboard discover|request|list|status|retry|revoke`
- 同一 Hub 根操作：`pair` / `targets` / `send` / `status` / `consume` 也支持显式 `--runtime <existing-hub-data-root>`；每个命令都要带同一根，详见文档。

边界：

readme.section: 手动接入 / 请求查询（当前入口）
readme.text:
- `request` 只登记，不等于 pair、owner enable 或 message received。
- 缺 consent 仍会持久保存为 `WAITING_OWNER_CONSENT`，不会 auto-pair/enable/send；`--user-authorized` 是调用方声明/授权引用，不是 PCA 认证。
- 可用显式 `--runtime <current-hub-data-root>` 接入已有旧 Hub，不要求 companion/locator 全切换。
- 旧私有 `adapters/codex/README.md`（v1）是历史说明，不是常驻入口，也不代表当前 receiver 两模式；receiver 当前模式以对应 README 为准。无需为改文档写私有 watched root/HMR。

readme.section: 可选 Codex receiver（以源/worker形式随包附带；默认不启用）
readme.text: 仓库和 npm bundle 现在都附带 `codex-receiver/` 的源码、worker 入口、shared core 和 receiver metadata（MIT）。但它**不是默认启用的桥**：`enabled=false` 起步，只有真实原 Codex owner 通过当前安装的 core CLI 显式 opt-in/enable 后，COMPANION_OWNED 才会恢复 ENABLED 成员；不会创建登录项，也不会扩展目标。legacy/source-link 安装模式仍独立说明，不自动迁移。

readme.section: 可选 Codex receiver（以源/worker形式随包附带；默认不启用）
readme.text:
- 要求：Windows 同一用户、Node `>=24.15.0`、用户已安装的 Codex CLI；`node:sqlite` 和 rollout 格式是强版本依赖。
- 入口、owner opt-in 与限制：[codex-receiver/README-CODEX.md](codex-receiver/README-CODEX.md)。
- 单独测试：`node --test codex-receiver/tests/*.test.mjs`。
- 没有 npm 发布 receiver 独立包、没有官方 Codex marketplace/plugin 挂载；真实第三方冷安装、登出/重启恢复、多日 soak、广泛升级矩阵仍是 NOT_RUN。

源码安装：

```powershell
node bin/lab-bridge.mjs uninstall-dsh-plugin
```

DSH bundle 安装：

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-local-bridge

readme.section: 确认没有其他 profile 使用后再清理运行态（会删除令牌、队列和日志）：
readme.text:
Remove-Item -Recurse -Force "$env:USERPROFILE\.dsh\local-agent-bridge"
```

安装器会保留字节级备份，只移除本项目自己的 profile 行；如果 profile 被外部修改，会拒绝覆盖冲突并提示人工检查。卸载/清理前请确认没有其他对话仍在使用该 Hub。

- Hub 只监听 loopback，不提供远程监听。
- 每个 Hub 使用 64 位十六进制令牌保护控制/数据连接。
- 配对是显式白名单；未配对的发送方/目标会被拒绝。
- `.local/` 含令牌、队列状态和日志，已加入 `.gitignore`。
- 不要把 `.local/` 内容或令牌贴进 issue。

- 单机、单用户；不是服务。
- 手动配对；没有自动发现向导。
- 只有 CLI，没有 GUI。
- DSH profile 改动对版本敏感；请保留安装器生成的备份。
- npm bundle 附带可选的 Codex receiver 源码、worker 入口、shared core 和 receiver metadata；receiver/worker 默认不启用，必须由真实原 owner opt-in/enable。
- MCP App、host-management 模块仍排除；legacy/source-link 模式保持独立说明，不自动迁移。
- 受限 client request/reply 已接入；说明见 [CLIENT-ACCESS](docs/CLIENT-ACCESS.md)。本机 Codex 原 MRI 已完成一次真实 request/reply；云 dot 业务、DSH 当前宿主的新 plugin 实载仍未验证。
- companion lifecycle/安装模式说明见 [COMPANION-LIFECYCLE](docs/COMPANION-LIFECYCLE.md)。
- 尚未做独立冷机验证。
- 0.x 版本之间 API/状态格式可能变化。
- 支持为尽力而为，无 SLA。

[简体中文](README.md) | English

> English translation. The canonical documentation is [简体中文](README.md). This translation may lag behind the Chinese canonical version.

> Durable, same-machine messaging between DeepSeek Harness (DSH) conversations, using a small local hub and a DSH host plugin.

**Status: alpha / research preview.** This is a personal, Windows-focused project, not a polished product. The supported surface is deliberately narrow. Read [What this is not](#what-this-is-not) before using it.

- A **local hub** on `127.0.0.1` with durable state, message TTL, retries, dedupe, pairing, and an audit event log.
- A **DSH host plugin** that delivers inbound messages into the exact live DSH conversation and exposes `bridge_send`, `bridge_status`, and `bridge_targets` tools.
- A **CLI** for hub lifecycle, pairing, sending, status, consumption, and reversible plugin install/uninstall.
- Built for one OS user running multiple DSH conversations on the same Windows machine.
Successful delivery means "the target DSH conversation received the message and a model turn was started". Message acceptance alone is not delivery proof.

- Not a universal agent-to-agent protocol.
- Not a cross-machine, cloud, or multi-user service.
- Not an unattended Codex bridge. The current bundle **ships** the optional Codex receiver source, worker entry, shared core and receiver metadata, but receivers/workers are disabled by default; they can start only after the real original Codex owner explicitly opts in and enables them. The receiver remains experimental and build-specific; legacy/source-link installs stay separate and are not auto-migrated.
- Not a GUI or a hosted product.
- No guarantee of compatibility with DSH versions other than the tested build.
- No promise of "open box" support for every DSH conversation.

```text
DSH conversation A
  └─ host plugin (outbound tool) ──┐
                                   ▼
                            local hub (127.0.0.1)

The hub listens on loopback only. Pairing is an explicit allowlist: an unpaired identity cannot send or receive. Runtime state (token, queue, logs, plugin backups) lives under `.local/` and is never committed.

- Windows 10/11 (tested; other platforms are not supported in this alpha).
- Node.js 22 or 24.
- DSH Desktop 0.2.1-rc.2 (tested build; other versions may work but are unverified).
- One OS user; one machine.

Replace `<session-id>` with an actual DSH session id. Run commands from the repository root.

```powershell
node --test

readme.section: Create local runtime config (token, hub state directory)
readme.text: node bin/lab-bridge.mjs init

readme.section: Terminal 1: run the hub and keep it running
readme.text: node hub/main.mjs

readme.section: Terminal 2: verify reachability and pair a DSH conversation
readme.text:
node bin/lab-bridge.mjs check
node bin/lab-bridge.mjs pair add 'dsh:session-<session-id>' --label 'DSH session'

readme.section: Install the DSH host plugin (reversible; writes backups before editing the profile)
readme.text:
node bin/lab-bridge.mjs install-dsh-plugin
node bin/lab-bridge.mjs dsh-plugin-status
```

From a paired DSH conversation:

```text
bridge_send to='dsh:session-<session-id>' text='hello'
bridge_status msg_id='<message-id>'
bridge_service_status
```

CLI operations:

readme.section: Install the DSH host plugin (reversible; writes backups before editing the profile)
readme.text:
```powershell
node bin/lab-bridge.mjs send --to 'dsh:session-<session-id>' --text 'hello through the bridge'
node bin/lab-bridge.mjs status --msg-id <message-id>
node bin/lab-bridge.mjs consume --msg-id <message-id> --consumer 'dsh:session-<session-id>' --note 'handled'
node bin/lab-bridge.mjs service-status
```

The DSH plugin manager can install this bundle from GitHub or a local path. After installation the plugin **starts and manages the Hub automatically** (an existing Hub is reused; set `manageHub: false` to manage it yourself). The Hub is still a separate child process, but users no longer need to locate a CLI under node_modules. If the child exits unexpectedly, the companion restarts it with bounded backoff; an existing/external Hub is reused and never stopped.

> The plugin manager needs `pnpm`. If the CLI reports `pnpm not found`, install pnpm first or use the Desktop Plugins page install entry. Installation performs version/build checks and may ask for confirmation.

```powershell

readme.section: GitHub (requires DSH 0.2.1-rc.2; the bundle declares engines.dsh)
readme.text: dsh plugin --profile web add github:suancaiyu10108899/dsh-local-bridge
dsh plugin --profile web add D:\Dev\dsh-local-bridge-public

readme.section: Installed bundles use $DSH_HOME/local-agent-bridge/runtime for mutable state.
readme.text:
$cli = "$env:USERPROFILE\.dsh\profiles\web\node_modules\.bin\dsh-local-bridge.cmd"
& $cli init       # first run only; managed Hub startup also creates config/token
& $cli pair add 'dsh:session-<session-id>' --label 'DSH session'
& $cli check      # diagnostics; no manual `serve` when the plugin manages the Hub
& $cli service-status
```

With `manageHub: false`, start the Hub explicitly with `& $cli serve`.

readme.section: Installed bundles use $DSH_HOME/local-agent-bridge/runtime for mutable state.
readme.text: With a local `link:` checkout, runtime stays in the checkout's `.local/runtime`; keep using the source quickstart above.

readme.section: Optional Codex receiver (source/worker included; disabled by default)
readme.text: The repository and npm bundle now include `codex-receiver/` source, worker entry, shared core and receiver metadata (MIT). It is **not an enabled bridge by default**: configs start `enabled=false`, and only the real original Codex owner can opt in/enable through the installed core CLI; a COMPANION_OWNED companion then restores only ENABLED members. It creates no login entry and expands no targets. Legacy/source-link installs remain separate and are not auto-migrated.

readme.section: Optional Codex receiver (source/worker included; disabled by default)
readme.text:
- Requirements: same-user Windows, Node `>=24.15.0`, a user-installed Codex CLI; `node:sqlite` and rollout format are version-sensitive.
- Entry, owner opt-in and limits: [codex-receiver/README-CODEX.md](codex-receiver/README-CODEX.md).
- Test separately: `node --test codex-receiver/tests/*.test.mjs`.
- The receiver is not published as a separate npm package and has no official Codex marketplace/plugin mounting; real third-party cold install, sign-out/reboot recovery, multi-day soak, and broad upgrade matrices remain NOT_RUN.

```powershell
node bin/lab-bridge.mjs uninstall-dsh-plugin
```

The installer keeps byte-level backups and only removes its own profile rows. If the profile was edited externally, the installer refuses to overwrite the conflict and asks for manual review.

- Hub listens on loopback only; no remote listener.
- A per-hub 64-hex token protects the control/data connection.
- Pairing is an explicit allowlist; unpaired senders/targets are rejected.
- `.local/` contains tokens, queue state, and logs; it is gitignored.
- Do not share `.local/` or paste its contents into issues.

- One machine, one OS user; not a service.
- Manual pairing; no discovery wizard.
- CLI only; no GUI.
- DSH profile mutation is version-sensitive; keep the generated backups.
- The npm bundle includes optional Codex receiver source/worker/shared-core/metadata; receivers and workers are disabled by default and require real original-owner opt-in/enable.
- MCP App and host-management modules remain excluded; legacy/source-link installs remain separate and are not auto-migrated.
- Restricted client request/reply is integrated; see [CLIENT-ACCESS](docs/CLIENT-ACCESS.md). One local Codex MRI request/reply was validated; cloud dot business acceptance and loading the new plugin in the current DSH host remain unverified.
- Companion lifecycle/install modes: [COMPANION-LIFECYCLE](docs/COMPANION-LIFECYCLE.md).
- No independent cold-machine validation yet.
- API and state formats may change between 0.x releases.
- Support is best-effort; there is no SLA.
